description: Pure-code time-series momentum (Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012, 'Time Series Momentum', JFE 104:228-250): monthly, long or short each cross-asset instrument by the sign of its 12-month return in excess of T-bills, confidence from excess return / EWMA (60-day centre of mass) volatility, one-month hold. Zero LLM tokens; a baseline AI shadows must beat.
output_character: monthly long/short directional calls on a cross-asset ETF + crypto universe, one-month hold, ATR disaster stop
public_data_sources: public daily price bars via gateway.price_history (complete bars only)
author: MarketMind (pure code, owner decision 2026-09-29)
